title: DASFAA 2027 Call for Research Papers
institution: International Conference on Database Systems for Advanced Applications 2027 (DASFAA 2027)
about: Research track of the 32nd DASFAA conference, 27-30 May 2027 in Shenyang, China. Papers are due 25 November 2026 (AoE) with no extensions planned; notifications on 25 January 2027 and camera-ready versions by 20 February 2027.
requirements: Deadlines are 23:59 Anywhere on Earth and fixed (no extensions planned)
